sql: SELECT T1.name FROM enlist T1 JOIN enrolled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.school)=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT T1.organ)=2
SELECT CAST(SUM(month=0)-SUM(month=9) AS REAL)*100/SUM(month=0) FROM longest_absense_from_school
SELECT T1.name FROM male T1 JOIN unemployed T2 ON T1.name=T2.name JOIN disabled T3 ON T1.name=T3.name JOIN longest_absense_from_school T4 ON T1.name=T4.name WHERE T4.month=5
SELECT SUM(m.name IS NOT NULL)-SUM(m.name IS NULL) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy f LEFT JOIN male m ON f.name=m.name

SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month=0)-SUM(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month=0) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name), IIF(SUM(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month=0)-SUM(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month=0)>0,'YES','NO') FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 LEFT JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name
SELECT CAST(COUNT(m.name) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(e.name) FROM enrolled e JOIN enlist l ON e.name=l.name LEFT JOIN male m ON e.name=m.name WHERE e.school='ucla' AND l.organ='air_force'
SELECT CAST(SUM(e.school='uci' AND m.name IS NULL) AS REAL)/COUNT(e.name) FROM enrolled e JOIN disabled d ON e.name=d.name LEFT JOIN male m ON e.name=m.name
